name: 44-itqiirpak
description: Itqiirpak: a giant monstrous tan flesh hand standing palm-out, mouths on every fingertip and a gaping mouth in the palm.

idle.action: The giant hand stands palm-out in place: its fingers slowly flex and spread, the fingertip mouths gnash open and shut, and the big palm mouth opens wide and closes. The wrist stays planted. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No effects.
